sources.entry: Loadout - Inspects and manages the skills, slash commands, subagents, plugins and MCP servers that coding assistants load, with usage counts read from session logs.

summary.one_liner: Loadout is a macOS app that inspects, toggles and edits the skills, slash commands, subagents, plugins and MCP servers used by coding assistants, and shows how often each one actually fires.
use_cases: Audit which skills and MCP servers a coding assistant loads
Find out which skills or commands are actually used
Turn off a skill or plugin without deleting it
Share one skill across Claude Code, Codex and other assistants
Create or edit skills, commands and subagents with validation
Move a project-local skill into personal use
how_to_run: Or download the DMG from loadout.migsilva.dev and drag Loadout.app into /Applications
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd loadout, ./Scripts/build-app.sh
notable: Usage counts read from the assistants' own session logs, marked unsupported where history cannot prove activation
Per-item on/off switches, including single skills inside plugins, that survive plugin updates
Shares a skill across assistants as symlinks to one real copy
Chat panel uses an installed assistant CLI with no API key; changes are proposed and accepted one by one
Backups before every write; deletes go to the Trash
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel
Codex local plugin controls need an installed Codex version supporting its plugin inventory protocol
Personal project maintained when it suits; no product support promise
